units.source_text: 内藏助一边思考一边舒展开了眉头，隔着火盆，他对吉田忠左卫门说：“今天很暖和啊。”

en.t: As he thought it over, Kuranosuke smoothed his brow and, across the brazier, said to Yoshida Chuzaemon, "It is warm today, isn't it?"

units.source_text: 吉田忠左卫门可能是看书看累了，他把书放在膝上，用手指比划着练字。

en.t: Yoshida Chuzaemon seemed to have grown tired of reading; he rested the book on his knees and practiced writing by tracing characters with his finger.

units.source_text: 天气很好，就这么闲着，一直到想睡觉为止。”

en.t: The weather is fine, so let us just idle away the time like this until we feel sleepy."
